goals.description: Identify database configuration files, MyBatis XML/raw SQL locations, MyBatis-Plus settings, entity classes using key sequences, deleted/logic-delete fields, GROUP BY queries, and any dal.mysql package or namespace references.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Focus only on gathering migration context. Locate the relevant YAML/properties files, mapper XML files, raw SQL, Java mapper/entity classes, MyBatis-Plus configuration, @KeySequence usages, deleted field comparisons, GROUP BY queries, and dal.mysql references. Do not perform edits yet except note what must change.
goals.name: inspect migration surface

goals.description: Change datasource configuration from MySQL to PostgreSQL format, add or preserve the intended currentSchema parameter, and replace MySQL/Oracle validation queries such as SELECT 1 FROM DUAL with SELECT 1.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Focus on JDBC/application configuration only. Convert MySQL datasource URLs to PostgreSQL URLs with the appropriate currentSchema when applicable, and change validation-query values from SELECT 1 FROM DUAL to SELECT 1. Avoid unrelated SQL mapper edits in this goal.
goals.name: update JDBC configuration

goals.description: Replace MySQL IFNULL usages in mapper XML or raw SQL with PostgreSQL-compatible COALESCE expressions.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Focus only on null-handling SQL dialect changes. Search mapper XML and raw SQL for IFNULL(...) and convert each usage to COALESCE(...) while preserving argument order and query meaning.
goals.name: convert null-handling SQL

goals.description: Convert MySQL date/time functions and casts to PostgreSQL equivalents, including DATE_FORMAT to TO_CHAR, DATE_ADD interval expressions to PostgreSQL interval arithmetic, CURDATE() to CURRENT_DATE, CAST AS DATETIME to CAST AS TIMESTAMP, and DATE(x) to CAST(x AS DATE).
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Focus only on date/time SQL dialect changes in mapper XML and raw SQL. Convert DATE_FORMAT, DATE_ADD(... INTERVAL ...), CURDATE(), CAST(... AS DATETIME), and DATE(...) patterns to PostgreSQL-compatible syntax. Pay attention to PostgreSQL TO_CHAR format tokens and interval literal syntax.
goals.name: convert date and time SQL

goals.description: Replace MySQL insert conflict syntax, including INSERT IGNORE and INSERT ... ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE, with PostgreSQL INSERT ... ON CONFLICT forms.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Focus only on upsert and duplicate-handling SQL. Convert INSERT IGNORE to INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING, and convert ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE to PostgreSQL ON CONFLICT (...) DO UPDATE SET ..., choosing the appropriate conflict target from the table key or existing SQL context.
goals.name: convert upsert SQL

goals.description: Rewrite MySQL UPDATE ... JOIN statements as PostgreSQL UPDATE ... SET ... FROM ... WHERE statements with join conditions moved into the WHERE clause.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Focus only on MySQL multi-table UPDATE JOIN syntax. Rewrite each UPDATE ... JOIN ... SET ... WHERE ... query into PostgreSQL UPDATE ... SET ... FROM ... WHERE ..., preserving aliases, assignments, join predicates, and filters.
goals.name: convert update join SQL

goals.description: Update MyBatis-Plus logic-delete and logic-not-delete configuration values for PostgreSQL BIT columns from integer literals to BIT literals B'1' and B'0'.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Focus only on MyBatis-Plus logic-delete configuration. If the project uses BIT/BIT(1) deleted flags, change logic-delete-value to "B'1'" and logic-not-delete-value to "B'0'" so generated SQL no longer compares BIT columns to integers.
goals.name: fix MyBatis-Plus logic delete literals

goals.description: Replace handwritten SQL comparisons against deleted BIT fields from deleted = 0 or deleted = 1 to deleted = B'0' or deleted = B'1' in mapper XML/raw SQL.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Focus only on handwritten deleted field comparisons in SQL. Search all mapper XML/raw SQL for deleted = 0 and deleted = 1, including spacing variants, count the affected locations, and replace them with deleted = B'0' and deleted = B'1' where the column is a BIT/BIT(1) logical-delete flag.
goals.name: fix handwritten deleted BIT comparisons

goals.description: For each MyBatis-Plus @KeySequence usage or migrated AUTO_INCREMENT table, ensure the corresponding PostgreSQL sequence exists in the correct schema and starts above the current maximum table ID.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Focus only on auto-increment and sequence migration. Find @KeySequence usages and AUTO_INCREMENT-derived IDs, verify or create the matching PostgreSQL sequences in the intended schema, and set each sequence start/current value higher than SELECT MAX(id) for its table to avoid primary-key collisions.
goals.name: prepare PostgreSQL sequences

goals.description: Review aggregate queries and make PostgreSQL GROUP BY semantics valid by adding selected non-aggregate columns to GROUP BY or wrapping them in suitable aggregate functions such as MAX, MIN, or BOOL_OR.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Focus only on GROUP BY compatibility. Inspect queries with GROUP BY and ensure every SELECT expression is either grouped or aggregated. Use business-safe fixes: add uniquely determined columns to GROUP BY, or wrap status/flag/value columns with MAX, MIN, BOOL_OR, or another appropriate aggregate.
goals.name: fix GROUP BY strictness

goals.description: If this migration includes package renaming, change MyBatis paths and references from dal.mysql to dal.pg, including source directories, XML namespaces, Java imports, and related logging/monitoring package configuration.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Focus only on the optional dal.mysql to dal.pg namespace/package refactor. If applicable, rename source directories, update mapper XML namespace values, update Java imports/package references, and adjust application logging or monitoring package configuration. If the project is not doing this refactor, record it as not applicable.
goals.name: refactor MyBatis package namespace

goals.description: Run final checks for remaining MySQL-only syntax and common PostgreSQL migration errors, and verify configuration, SQL dialect changes, BIT literals, sequences, GROUP BY queries, and optional namespace refactoring are complete.
goals.goal_entering_prompt: Focus on validation only. Search for leftover MySQL dialect patterns such as jdbc:mysql, SELECT 1 FROM DUAL, IFNULL, DATE_FORMAT, DATE_ADD, CURDATE(), CAST AS DATETIME, INSERT IGNORE, ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE, UPDATE JOIN syntax, and deleted integer comparisons. Confirm sequences and GROUP BY fixes, run available tests or build checks, and report any remaining migration risks.
goals.name: validate PostgreSQL migration
